dependencies.name: SDL
dependencies.purpose: Windows, input, events, Vulkan surface creation (engine/platform)

dependencies.name: Vulkan Memory Allocator (VMA)
dependencies.purpose: GPU memory allocation for buffers and images (engine/render)

dependencies.name: DirectX Shader Compiler (dxc, from the Vulkan SDK)
dependencies.purpose: Compiles HLSL shaders to SPIR-V during the build

dependencies.name: Vulkan SDK (loader + headers)
dependencies.linkage: dynamic (vulkan-1.dll is provided by the GPU driver)
dependencies.purpose: Graphics API; installed by developer, runtime loader comes with drivers

dependencies.name: Avalonia (+ Desktop, Themes.Fluent)
dependencies.purpose: Editor GUI toolkit (ADR-003). Currently used by spikes/avalonia_viewport

dependencies.name: Avalonia.Fonts.Inter (Inter typeface)
dependencies.purpose: Editor UI typeface; OFL bundling allowed per ADR-019

dependencies.name: Dock (Dock.Avalonia, Dock.Model.Mvvm, Dock.Avalonia.Themes.Fluent)
dependencies.purpose: Editor docking panels and floating windows (ADR-003)
